items.rationale: Cost of establishing cause and extent under 5.2.6(b), capped at EUR 3,000, which is not reached. Price level follows case 20 (>=481) and the prior (~524).
Leak location is covered under 5.2.6(a). The EUR 1,000 cap is shared with the technician time in line 3; about 650 + 180 stays within it.
On-site technician time is expressly included in 5.2.6(a), within the shared EUR 1,000 cap. 2.5 h at roughly 70/h.
One vehicle charge per contractor per invoice under 5.2.6(c), capped at EUR 70 net (83.30 gross). The prior is about 79.

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, porosity from material ageing counts as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking, so the two weeping joints are covered. 9.1.1 confirms ageing alone is not a breach. Priced in line with cases 27 and 21.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: 2.4.3 states that sections not shown to be leaking are not covered, and 7.1.5 excludes work on unaffected parts.
This is betterment, excluded by 7.1.9 and 7.1.8(a), and it relates to uncovered sections anyway.
One vehicle charge per contractor per invoice for the repair journey, allowed under 5.2.6(c). Capped at EUR 70 net (83.30 gross).
